SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM onsetDateTime) AS diagnosis_year, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = 'D16.5' AND system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10' AND onsetDateTime IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY diagnosis_year
            ORDER BY diagnosis_year

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM authoredOn) AS rx_year, COUNT(*) AS rx_count
            FROM medication_request
            WHERE code = '235389' AND system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' AND authoredOn IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY rx_year
            ORDER BY rx_year

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM effectiveDateTime) AS obs_year, ROUND(AVG(valueQuantity), 4) AS avg_value
            FROM observation
            WHERE code = '5797-6' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND effectiveDateTime IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY obs_year
            ORDER BY obs_year

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM performedDateTime) AS proc_year, COUNT(*) AS proc_count
            FROM procedure
            WHERE code = '47758006' AND system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND performedDateTime IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY proc_year
            ORDER BY proc_year

SELECT p.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = '59621000' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY p.gender

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = '403190006' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND DATE_DIFF('year', p.birthDate, c.onsetDateTime) >= 65

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = 'D16.4' AND c.system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10'
              AND DATE_DIFF('year', p.birthDate, c.onsetDateTime) >= 65
concept_display: Benign neoplasm of bones of skull and face

question: What's the average body weight of patients who have gingivitis?

            FROM condition c

            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND o.code = '29463-7' AND o.system = 'http://loinc.org'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.valueQuantity), 4) AS avg_weight, o.unit
            FROM condition c
            JOIN observation o ON c.patient_id = o.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '58150001' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND o.code = '29463-7' AND o.system = 'http://loinc.org'
            GROUP BY o.unit

SELECT p.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM immunization i
            JOIN patient p ON i.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE i.vaccineCode = '03' AND i.vaccineCode_system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx'
            GROUP BY p.gender

question: On average, how many procedures does a patient with gingivitis undergo?
sql:
SELECT AVG(proc_count) AS avg_procedures_per_patient
            FROM (
                SELECT c.patient_id, COUNT(pr.id) AS proc_count
                FROM condition c
                LEFT JOIN procedure pr ON c.patient_id = pr.patient_id
                WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ) sub

SELECT COUNT(*) AS report_count
            FROM diagnostic_report dr
            JOIN condition c ON dr.patient_id = c.patient_id
            WHERE dr.code = '87674-8' AND dr.system = 'http://loinc.org'
              AND c.code = '59621000' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'

SELECT e.class_code, COUNT(*) AS rx_count
            FROM medication_request m
            JOIN encounter e ON m.encounter_id = e.id
            WHERE m.code = '749882' AND m.system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
            GROUP BY e.class_code
            ORDER BY rx_count DESC

question: For each patient, how has their leukocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count changed between their first and most recent reading?
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT patient_id, valueQuantity, effectiveDateTime,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime ASC, id ASC) AS rn_first,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime DESC, id ASC) AS rn_last
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '6690-2' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND valueQuantity IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT f.patient_id, f.valueQuantity AS first_value, l.valueQuantity AS last_value,
                   l.valueQuantity - f.valueQuantity AS delta
            FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1) f
            JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1) l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id
            WHERE f.patient_id != l.patient_id OR f.effectiveDateTime != l.effectiveDateTime

                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime ASC, id ASC) AS rn_first,

            )

WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT patient_id, valueQuantity, effectiveDateTime,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime ASC, id ASC) AS rn_first,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effectiveDateTime DESC, id ASC) AS rn_last
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '77606-2' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND valueQuantity IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT f.patient_id, f.valueQuantity AS first_value, l.valueQuantity AS last_value,
                   l.valueQuantity - f.valueQuantity AS delta
            FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1) f
            JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1) l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id
            WHERE f.patient_id != l.patient_id OR f.effectiveDateTime != l.effectiveDateTime

SELECT o.patient_id, o.valueQuantity, o.effectiveDateTime
            FROM observation o
            JOIN condition c ON o.patient_id = c.patient_id
            WHERE o.code = '3094-0' AND o.system = 'http://loinc.org'
              AND c.code = '59621000' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.patient_id ORDER BY o.effectiveDateTime DESC) = 1
concept_display: Urea nitrogen [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = '399261000' AND system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY patient_id
            ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC, patient_id
            LIMIT 5

SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = 'K08.409' AND system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10'
            GROUP BY patient_id
            ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC, patient_id
            LIMIT 5

question: On average, how long after a gingivitis diagnosis do patients start on lisinopril?
sql:
SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.onsetDateTime, m.first_rx)) AS avg_days_to_treatment
            FROM condition c
            JOIN (
                SELECT patient_id, MIN(authoredOn) AS first_rx
                FROM medication_request
                WHERE code = '314076' AND system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
                GROUP BY patient_id
            ) m ON c.patient_id = m.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND m.first_rx >= c.onsetDateTime

question: What's the average time between a patient's gingivitis diagnosis and their first lisinopril prescription?
sql:
SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.onsetDateTime, m.first_rx)) AS avg_days_to_treatment
            FROM condition c
            JOIN (
                SELECT patient_id, MIN(authoredOn) AS first_rx
                FROM medication_request

SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.onsetDateTime, m.first_rx)) AS avg_days_to_treatment
            FROM condition c
            JOIN (
                SELECT patient_id, MIN(authoredOn) AS first_rx
                FROM medication_request
                WHERE code = '314076' AND system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
                GROUP BY patient_id
            ) m ON c.patient_id = m.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '698306007' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND m.first_rx >= c.onsetDateTime

SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.onsetDateTime, m.first_rx)) AS avg_days_to_treatment
            FROM condition c
            JOIN (
                SELECT patient_id, MIN(authoredOn) AS first_rx
                FROM medication_request
                WHERE code = '314076' AND system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
                GROUP BY patient_id
            ) m ON c.patient_id = m.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = 'C32.1' AND c.system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10'
              AND m.first_rx >= c.onsetDateTime

question: How has the average leukocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count changed year over year?
sql:
WITH yearly AS (
                SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM effectiveDateTime) AS yr, ROUND(AVG(valueQuantity), 4) AS avg_val
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '6690-2' AND system = 'http://loinc.org' AND effectiveDateTime IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY yr
            )
            SELECT yr, avg_val, avg_val - LAG(avg_val) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS yoy_delta
            FROM yearly
            ORDER BY yr

SELECT c.patient_id, MIN(DATE_DIFF('year', p.birthDate, c.onsetDateTime)) AS age_at_first_diagnosis
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = '70704007' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ORDER BY age_at_first_diagnosis DESC, c.patient_id
            LIMIT 5

SELECT c.patient_id, MIN(DATE_DIFF('year', p.birthDate, c.onsetDateTime)) AS age_at_first_diagnosis
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.id
            WHERE c.code = '398254007' AND c.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ORDER BY age_at_first_diagnosis DESC, c.patient_id
            LIMIT 5
